We welcome you to the Youth Commission meeting.

If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and
give it to the secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes. If
you wish to address the Commission on an item which appears on the agenda, your comments will
be heard during the Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the Commission
on a subject which does not appear on the agenda but related to recreation or community service,
you may make your presentation under agenda item VII. Please be advised that the Commission
cannot, under the State of California’s Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on any item which does
not appear on the agenda.

When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record. Please make
your statement as brief as possible. Thank you.

minutes_text:
APPROVED by: Youth Commission on June 11, 2019

  MINUTES
  Alhambra Youth Commission
  March 12, 2019

The Alhambra Youth Commission was called to order at 6:00 pm on March 12, 2019 at the
Alhambra Public Library Conference Room, 101 S. First Street, Alhambra, CA.

Commission Members Present: Hu, Gonzalez, Jimenez, Martinez, Placido, and Romero

Commission Members Absent: Duong, Garcia, Gutierrez, Luc, Olmeda, and Pham

Also present: Vincent Hon, Recreation Supervisor.

III.  APPROVAL OF THE JANUARY 8, 2019 YOUTH COMMISSION
  MEETING MINUTES

  On the motion from Commissioner Martinez and second by Commissioner Romero
  the Minutes of January 8, 2019 were approved.

IV.  DISCUSSION REGARDING SPRING EGGSTRAVAGANZA
  VOLUNTEER OPPORTUNITY

  Recreation Supervisor Hon explains that the Easter event will be one of the biggest
  events held by the City. The event will be held on Saturday, April 20th from 8am-
  11am. Mr. Hon goes on to explain that the event will be split into two phases
  reflecting two different age ranges. The face painting portion of the event will be
  replaced with “painting your Easter face” where participants will get their faces
  painted like an “Easter bunny” with whiskers and a nose. There will be also be an
  ear decorating table as well, where the participants can decorate their own set of
  “bunny ears”. There will also be an inflatable maze, a photo booth, and food
  vendor.

  Recreation Supervisor Hon stated that he needs 20 volunteers for this event but
  Commissioner Martinez from Mark Keppel High School said that she could bring
  10 or more volunteers for this event. Recreation Supervisor Hon asked if anyone
  would want to volunteer for the event. Commissioner Gonzalez said that she could
  volunteer for the event and Recreation Supervisor Hon acknowledged this and said
  he would provide more information about the event in an email. Commissioner
  Romero explained that she will not be able to volunteer for this event. Mr. Hon
  went on to describe what duties will be performed by volunteers during the event
  which included assisting kids decorate their “bunny ears” and assisting with face
  painting.

V.  DISCUSSION REGARDING UPCOMING SPECIAL EVENTS

  Recreation Supervisor Hon explains that the next upcoming event is the 626
  Golden Street event and he is the lead on the Alhambra Parks and Recreation side
  of the event. It is being promoted by Metro and SGV Bike Club. The City of
  Alhambra contribution to this event is to provide a HUB were bike riders can stop
  and visit vendors, food vendors and our Farmers Market. Mr. Hon explains that
   this could possibly be another chance for volunteer hours and that the event will
  take place on Sunday, May 19th and run from 9am-4pm. Recreation Supervisor
  Hon also explained that there will be a Memorial day event but he does not require
  volunteers for that event but he will need some volunteers for the 4th of July event.
  Recreation Supervisor Hon said that he will purchase more “blinkies” for the
  commissioners to sell for the 4th of July event and the amount sold will be donated
  to the Youth Commission groups that volunteered. Mr. Hon will need 60
  volunteers for that event.

  Recreation Supervisor Hon stated that another event that will occur in the summer
  is the “Movies in the Park” event. Mr. Hon explains that the first movie will be on
  June 29th and will be Lego Movie 2, the next movie will be Moana, the third movie
  will be Spiderman: Into the Spiderverse, the fourth movie will be Ralph Breaks the
  Internet, and the last one will be How to Train Your Dragon 2.

VI.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

  No guest speakers were present for the oral communication portion of the meeting.

VII.  COMMISSION ORALS

  No Commissioners had anything else to speak about.

VIII.  ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 6:35 p.m. by Recreation Supervisor Vincent Hon.
